FUEL SUPPLY
13C-6
CAUTION
When Tightening, be careful not to let the fuel pump 
module turn together with the cap. If the mating marks are 
misaligned, the float may measure a remaining amount of 
fuel in correctly, causing the low fuel warning light to 
malfunction.
7. Use special tool MB991480 to align the mating marks on the 
fuel tank and fuel pump module, and tighten the cap.
8. Check for leaks from the installation section of the fuel pump 
module by the following procedure.
(1) Apply soapy water to the inside diameter of the cap.
(2) Choke the vapor hose and main hose, apply an internal 
pressure of 10 kPa (1.45 psi) or less from the return hose 
and check that no bubbles form in the soapy water.
9. Connect the connector, and then install the protector.
10.Install the rear seat cushion. (Refer to GROUP 52A − Rear 
Seat P.52A-23.)
